'''Shrivel Braittrand''', a [[Kulless]] from [[Gerres Gule]], moved from his home [[Planet/Legends|planet]] to seek employment as a [[Podracing/Legends|race]] mechanic. He was hired by [[Boles Roor/Legends|Boles Roor]], [[Glimmik/Legends|glimmik]] singer and two-time winner of the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]]. After Roor's loss in the Boonta race, he quit Podracing and gave his pod to Braittrand, who modified it into the ''[[Kulless Squall]]'' and embarked on a quite successful racing career. He was one of the few [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|Podracing pilots]] not to meet his end during a race.

==Behind the scenes==
Shrivel Braittrand first appeared as a playable character in the [[2002]] [[Rainbow Studios]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Racer Revenge]]''. In the "tournament" game mode, the player can choose to play as Braittrand and win the Galactic Trials, [[Podracing Open]], and [[Hutt Championships]] tournaments. After winning the Hutt Championships, the Kulless is invited to the palace of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] to receive his trophy in the Hutt's throne room.<ref name="RR" />

Braittrand also appears in another ending for the tournament game mode, if the player wins it as [[Teemto Pagalies/Legends|Teemto Pagalies]]. After Pagalies is presented his trophy, Braittrand throws an object at the [[Veknoid/Legends|Veknoid's]] face, drawing the attention of the winner and the crowd. [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] guards then remove the Kulless from the throne room.<ref name="RR" />
